recentItems.title: Daquan Wright is quitting the NFL to go to college
recentItems.description:
An NFL player just quit the NFL... to go back to college.

Daquan Wright was on the Cleveland Brown’s preseason roster weeks ago. Now he's planning to suit up for LSU thanks to an NCAA eligibility rule change and a college football economy where top players can out-earn NFL practice squad money.

The line between Amateur and Professional sports continues to thin as America’s second favorite past time to the NFL, College Football, kicks off this week.

Jordan Rogers breaks it down.

recentItems.title: Dalton Rosta Gets His Nails Done & Talks MMA, PFL and Life | Knockout Nails
recentItems.description:
Dalton Rosta sits down for VICE Sports’ *Knockout Nails* to talk MMA, family, relationships, and his journey from Bellator to the PFL. The middleweight fighter opens up about what drives him, the people closest to him, and his goal of becoming a PFL champion.


ABOUT KNOCKOUT NAILS
This is Knockout Nails — where glam meets grit. We invite combat athletes—from boxers to MMA pros—to sit down for unexpected conversations while getting their nails done. In a space that disarms and humanizes, these fighters share what fuels them: from personal loss to glory dreams, gym life to mental health. It’s an intimate, stylized portrait of toughness — reimagined through self-expression, vulnerability, and cultural commentary. A VICE Sports original, the series blends beauty culture and fight culture in a way no one else does.
